```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)

df <- whole_df_long_selected %>%
  mutate(ADNI.petpos = as.character(ADNI.petpos)) %>%
  mutate(ADNI.petpos = ifelse(ADNI.petpos=='Missing', 'NA', ADNI.petpos)) %>%
  mutate(ADNI.petpos = factor(ADNI.petpos, levels = c("A-", "A+", "NA")))

region_max <- df %>%
  group_by(Region) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(region_max = max(TauSUVR, na.rm = TRUE))

stat_test <- df %>%
  group_by(Region) %>%
  pairwise_t_test(TauSUVR ~ ADNI.petpos, p.adjust.method = "BH") %>%
  mutate(
    p.signif = case_when(
      p.adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.adj < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p.adj < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(region_max, by = "Region") %>%
  mutate(
    y.position = case_when(
      group1 == "A+" & group2 == "NA" ~ region_max *1.05,
      group1 == "A-" & group2 == "A+" ~ region_max *1.1,
      group1 == "A-" & group2 == "NA" ~ region_max *1.15,
      TRUE                            ~ region_max + 0.2  # fallback
    )
  )


p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = ADNI.petpos, y = TauSUVR)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill=ADNI.petpos)) +
  facet_wrap(~ Region, scales = "free_y") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    data = stat_test,
    label = "p.signif",
    y.position = "y.position",
    xmin = "group1",
    xmax = "group2",
    tip.length = 0.01
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("A-" = "#1f77b4", "A+" = "#e41a1c", "NA" = "#999999")) +
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(x = "Amyloid Status", y = "Tau SUVR", fill = "Group") 
ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "tau_AD_boxplot.png"), plot = p, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

p
```

```{r}
lm_tauAgeAmyloid <- data.frame(
```

#### Table 2
```{r}
for (tau in colnames(amyloid_tau[1:6])){
  formula <- as.formula(paste(tau, "~ age + ADNI.petpos"))
  model <- lm(formula, data = amyloid_tau)
  coef_table<-coef(summary(model))
  for (var in rownames(coef_table[-1,])) {
    var_coef <- coef_table[var,]
    lm_tauAgeAmyloid <- rbind(lm_tauAgeAmyloid, data.frame(
      Feature = var,
      Estimate = var_coef["Estimate"],
      StdError = var_coef["Std. Error"],
      tValue = var_coef["t value"],
      Pr = var_coef["Pr(>|t|)"],  
      Model = tau
    ))
  }
}
```

#### Linear regression. age+sex+educg+amyloid -> speech markers



```{r}
cov_ls <- c("age", "sex", "Educg")

```


```{r}
# install.packages(c("glmmTMB", "marginaleffects"))
library(glmmTMB)
library(marginaleffects)
run_betaIZ <- function(outcome, predictor, covariates, data) {
  # Combine predictor and covariates into a formula string
  formula_str1 <- paste(" ~ ", paste(c(predictor, covariates), collapse = " + "))
  formula_str2 <- paste(outcome, formula_str1)
  
  # Convert to formula object
  formula_obj1 <- as.formula(formula_str1)
  formula_obj2 <- as.formula(formula_str2)
  
  # Fit zero-inflated beta regression model
  model <- glmmTMB(
    formula_obj2,  # mean of positive part (beta)
    ziformula = formula_obj1,  # zero-inflation model (Pr(“extra zero”))
    dispformula = formula_obj1, 
    family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
    data = data
  )
    
  # summary(model)
  
  # Average marginal effect of X on E[y | y>0, X]
  ave_me <- avg_slopes(
    model,
    variables = predictor,
    type = "response",            # on the y scale, not logit
    re.form = NA
  )

  # summary(ave_me)
  return(ave_me)
}
```


```{r}
run_betaIZ(feat1[1],'ADNI.petpos',cov_ls,amyloid_feature_lmd)
```


```{r}
run_gamma <- function(outcome, predictor, covariates, data) {
  # Combine predictor and covariates into a formula string
  formula_str1 <- paste(" ~ ", paste(c(predictor, covariates), collapse = " + "))
  formula_str2 <- paste(outcome, formula_str1)
  
  # Convert to formula object
  formula_obj1 <- as.formula(formula_str1)
  formula_obj2 <- as.formula(formula_str2)
  
  # Fit zero-inflated beta regression model
  model <- glm(
    formula_obj2,  # mean of positive part (beta)
    family = Gamma(link = "log"),
    data = data
  )
    
  # summary(model)
  # 
  # confint(model)        # 95% CIs for coefficients

  # Average marginal effect of X on E[y | y>0, X]
  ave_me <- avg_slopes(
    model,
    variables = predictor,
    type = "response"            # on the y scale, not logit
  )

  # summary(ave_me)
  return(ave_me)
}
```

```{r}
run_gamma(feat2[1], 'ADNI.petpos',cov_ls,amyloid_feature_lmd)
```



```{r}
library(MASS)

run_negbreg <- function(outcome, predictor, covariates, data) {
  # Combine predictor and covariates into a formula string
  formula_str1 <- paste(" ~ ", paste(c(predictor, covariates), collapse = " + "))
  formula_str2 <- paste(outcome, formula_str1)
  
  # Convert to formula object
  formula_obj1 <- as.formula(formula_str1)
  formula_obj2 <- as.formula(formula_str2)
  
  # Fit zero-inflated beta regression model
  model <- glm.nb(
    formula_obj2,  # mean of positive part (beta)
    data = data
  )
    
  # summary(model)

  # confint(model)        # 95% CIs for coefficients

  # Average marginal effect of X on E[y | y>0, X]
  ave_me <- avg_slopes(
    model,
    variables = predictor,
    type = "response"            # on the y scale, not logit
  )

  # summary(ave_me)
  return(ave_me)
}
```
```{r}
run_negbreg(feat3[1], 'ADNI.petpos',cov_ls,amyloid_feature_lmd)

```

```{r}
run_gaussian <- function(outcome, predictor, covariates, data) {
  # Combine predictor and covariates into a formula
  formula_str <- paste(outcome, "~", paste(c(predictor, covariates), collapse = " + "))
  formula_obj <- as.formula(formula_str)
  
  # Fit Gaussian regression model
  model <- glm(
    formula_obj,
    family = gaussian(),
    data = data
  )
  
  # Main model summary
  # print(summary(model))
  # 
  # Confidence intervals
  # print(confint(model))
  
  # Average marginal effects
  ave_me <- avg_slopes(
    model,
    variables = predictor,
    type = "response"   # effect on the original scale
  )
  
  # print(summary(ave_me))
  
  return(ave_me)
}
```

```{r}
run_gaussian(feat4[1], 'ADNI.petpos',cov_ls,amyloid_feature_lmd)

```

regression models were used with demographic variables (i.e., age, sex, education) and LMd predicting each feature
```{r}
lm_featureDemoLMd <- data.frame()

for (feature in colnames(feature_lmd)[2:55]) {

  if (feature %in% feat1) {
    print(feature)
    model_func <- run_betaIZ
    model_type <- "BetaIZ"
  } else if (feature %in% feat2) {
    model_func <- run_gamma
    model_type <- "Gamma"
  } else if (feature %in% feat3) {
    model_func <- run_negbreg
    model_type <- "NegBin"
  } else if (feature %in% c(feat4)) {
    model_func <- run_gaussian
    model_type <- "Gaussian"
  } else {
    warning(paste("Feature", feature, "not found in any type vector! Skipped."))
    next
  }
  
  ave_me <- model_func(
    outcome    = feature,
    predictor  = "LMd",
    covariates = c("age", "sex", "Educg"),
    data       = feature_lmd
  )
  
  tmp <- data.frame(
    Feature      = ave_me$term,
    Estimate     = ave_me$estimate,
    StdError     = ave_me$std.error,
    t_or_z_Value = ave_me$statistic,
    Pr           = ave_me$p.value,
    Outcome       = feature,
    CI_Lower     = ave_me$conf.low,
    CI_Upper     = ave_me$conf.high,
    Dist         = model_type
  )
  
  lm_featureDemoLMd <- rbind(lm_featureDemoLMd, tmp)
}

```

```{r}
lm_featureDemoAmyloidTauLmd <- data.frame()
for (tau in colnames(whole_df_clean[1:6])){
  for (feature in colnames(whole_df_clean)[8:61]) {
    if (feature %in% feat1) {
      model_func <- run_betaIZ
      model_type <- "BetaIZ"
    } else if (feature %in% feat2) {
      model_func <- run_gamma
      model_type <- "Gamma"
    } else if (feature %in% feat3) {
      model_func <- run_negbreg
      model_type <- "NegBin"
    } else if (feature %in% c(feat4)) {
      model_func <- run_gaussian
      model_type <- "Gaussian"
    } else {
      warning(paste("Feature", feature, "not found in any type vector! Skipped."))
      next
    }
    
    ave_me <- model_func(
      outcome    = feature,
      predictor  = tau,
      covariates = c("age", "sex", "Educg","ADNI.petpos",'LMd'),
      data       = whole_df_clean
    )
    
    tmp <- data.frame(
      Feature      = ave_me$term,
      Estimate     = ave_me$estimate,
      StdError     = ave_me$std.error,
      t_or_z_Value = ave_me$statistic,
      Pr           = ave_me$p.value,
      Outcome       = feature,
      CI_Lower     = ave_me$conf.low,
      CI_Upper     = ave_me$conf.high,
      Dist         = model_type
    )

}
```
